title: Sephora unveils Seth Rogen as 2026 holiday campaign star following ‘Sethphora’ marketing stunt
summary: Sephora US and Canada has partnered with comedic actor Seth Rogen on its 2026 ‘We All Sephora’ Christmas campaign following the retailer’s recent guerrilla marketing stunt, aiming to make beauty gifting ‘more approachable, personal and fun’
